system_prompt:
You are a fourth-grade student taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in your grade. Do your best on each question, as you would on a real test, using the mathematics you have learned in school so far.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
Darin asked his friends to name their favorite color. He collected the information in the table shown below.

| Favorite Color | Number of Friends |
| --- | --- |
| Red | 4 |
| Green | 2 |
| Blue | 6 |
| Yellow | 7 |

Then Darin started to draw a graph to show the information. Complete Darin’s graph.

[Image: Bar graph with title Favorite color, x-axis labeled Color, y-axis labeled Number of friends. Two columns labeled Red and Green are shown.]

Figure, described in words:
An incomplete vertical bar graph titled "Favorite Color". The vertical axis on the left is labeled "Number of Friends" with tick marks and horizontal grid lines at 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10. The horizontal axis at the bottom is labeled "Color" and has four equally spaced categories separated by tick marks, labeled from left to right: "Red", "Green", "Blue", and "Yellow". A gray bar of height 4 is drawn above "Red". A gray bar of height 2 is drawn above "Green". The spaces above "Blue" and "Yellow" are empty.

answer.description: Your answer to the question, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer.title: Answer

output.answer: Complete the graph by drawing a bar above the Blue category on the horizontal axis with its top at the 6 grid line on the vertical axis, since 6 friends chose Blue. Then draw a bar above the Yellow category with its top at the 7 mark on the vertical axis (halfway between the 6 and 8 grid lines), since 7 friends chose Yellow. The Red bar (height 4) and Green bar (height 2) are already correct and stay as they are.
